Fishing
The art of collecting fish.
Skill Type:
Trade Skill
Max Level:
90
Skill Trainers:
Ukorga
,
Rugen
“
The art of collecting fish.
Fishing Overview
Fishing
is a skill that increases as you collect fish from lakes and rivers outdoors.
Except for ice fishing, there is no fishing pole item required, nor animation. Simply swim up to a fish and pick them up! Press your up and down keys to dive.
The fish and other aquatic creatures collected with this skill are used in
cooking
,
alchemy
and other trade skills.
In-Game Description
The art of collecting fish.
Training Fishing
Ukorga
teaches the recipes for ice fishing.
Rugen
unlocks levels 51-60 and 61-70.
Levels 71-80 and 81-90 are unlocked by
Dunahain Broadarm
deep beneath
Povus
.
Connected Skills
Sub-Skills:
Angling
- A sub-skill of Fishing Orcish in origin.
Related Skills:
Cooking
- The fish caught through fishing can be used in cooking recipes.
Sushi Preparation
- The fish caught through fishing can be used in Sushi recipes.
Harvestables
Fish
Each time you catch a fish and clear the node it can respawn as another type of fish/crab.  So it is best to fish everything.
